visit_inventory.status: masked target aperture or local annulus

strongest_positive_visit.scope: Largest signed score at the target and at each fixed control site across the same visit scan. Partial controls have coverage in at least 80% of visits, including the peak visit, and may sample fewer opportunities for a noise peak. The ranks are descriptive because the references and control apertures share data. The aperture and reference variants reuse the peak visit.

scope: Signed photometry from observed Euclid DR1 H-band visit stacks, using only positive finite RMS and zero-flag data-quality pixels. Per-visit measurements use leave-one-out references, and monthly stacks use the median. Local control scatter includes noise and unresolved light. No PSF matching or aperture correction, and no constraint outside the returned visits.
